zh.summary: 围绕临床试验建立一份可版本化的共同记录，把方案、预算与执行文件连起来。
zh.judgment: 有价值的切口是减少方案变更后的重复协调；是否成为生意，要看团队复核负担和试验启动周期。
zh.replaces: 试验团队分散在文档、邮件和预算表中协调版本，并反复比对历史项目。
zh.product: 官网描述为申办方和合同研究组织提供共同试验记录，并辅助形成方案、提交材料及运营计划。这里的“临床”是研发与试验工作流，不应误写成面向患者的诊断工具。
zh.customer: 潜在使用者是试验设计、临床运营和商业团队，买方可能是申办公司或 CRO，此为商业推断。需求来自多角色协调与变更返工；最容易验证的回报是一次方案变更影响多少文件、耗费多少复核工时。
zh.workflow: 官网说明整合组织历史项目和外部资料，设计变化联动预算与文件，并由临床团队决策。可验证的实施重点是证据出处、版本差异、审批人和例外处理能否贯穿同一记录，而不是自动生成文本越多越好。
zh.business_model: 公开价格和合同经济未在本次资料中确认。项目级或机构级合同是可研究的商业假设；数据整理、部署和客户审查可能形成较高前置成本，需要看同一家机构后续试验能否复用配置。
zh.traction: 公开资料能确认产品定位与演示流程，不能确认付费试验数或真实启动周期改善。本次未见可比项目的独立效率对照或续费数据；团队精简是价值主张，不能直接当作经验证的人员节省。
zh.moat: 通用模型可辅助写文档，却未必维护方案、预算与责任记录的一致性。潜在壁垒在机构历史决策知识、数据结构与变更传播能力；若只能做检索加起草，就容易被已有协作工具吸收。
zh.funding_read: 种子轮为早期工作流验证提供资本，并不说明已完成广泛采购验证。下一里程碑可看同一客户在第二个试验持续采用、一次变更的返工时间，以及交付成本能否下降；估值和详细预算未确认。
zh.risks: 首先，错误的资料关联可能扩大复核范围；其次，敏感数据接入与机构采购会拖长上线周期。跨项目流程差异也可能让复用率不及预期，需要把这些成本纳入合同与扩张判断。
zh.takeaway: 可借鉴“共同记录驱动多份交付物”的设计。对复杂专业服务，应优先确定一份权威结构化记录、变更责任和审批路径，再增加生成能力；这样才能减少整个流程的返工。
zh.watch_next: 看同客户复用试验数、变更到完成审查的时长、需要人工纠正的关联错误与实施工时。真实项目对照如果显示启动更快且复核不增加，才是比融资更强的产品价值证据。

en.summary: A versioned shared trial record connecting design, budgets and operational documents.
en.judgment: Reducing coordination after design changes is the useful wedge; review burden and startup time determine commercial value.
en.replaces: Coordinating versions across documents, email and budgets while repeatedly checking earlier trials.
en.product: The site describes a shared record for sponsors and CROs that assists plans and trial documents. This is a research workflow product, not a patient diagnostic service.
en.customer: Design, operations and commercial teams are plausible users; sponsors and CROs are plausible buyers. This is a commercial inference. Change-driven rework provides a concrete target for measuring value.
en.workflow: The described workflow draws on historical organisational material and external sources, connecting changes across outputs while teams make decisions. Evidence, versions, approvals and exceptions should remain traceable throughout.
en.business_model: Public prices and contract economics were not established. Project or institution contracts are hypotheses. Data preparation and deployment could create substantial initial costs; reuse on later trials would improve the economics.
en.traction: Product positioning and demonstrations do not establish paid trial counts or faster startup. Comparable independent outcomes and renewals were not found here. Leaner staffing remains a proposition rather than a verified saving.
en.moat: Generic models can draft text without maintaining cross-document consistency. Institutional decision history, structured data and change propagation might be defensible. Retrieval and drafting alone would be easier for incumbents to absorb.
en.funding_read: Seed capital supports workflow validation without proving broad procurement acceptance. Reuse on a second trial and lower change-review effort would be useful milestones. Valuation and detailed allocation were not established.
en.risks: Wrong source associations could widen review work. Sensitive-data access and procurement may delay deployment. Different project practices could also reduce reuse and increase contract delivery costs.
en.takeaway: Borrow the shared-record approach to multiple deliverables. Define the authoritative structure, change ownership and approval path before adding generation, so the whole process creates less rework.
en.watch_next: Watch repeat trials per customer, change-to-review time, association errors and implementation hours. Faster real projects without added review burden would be stronger evidence than funding.

evidence.text: The company has developed an AI workspace that brings together an organisation’s knowledge from previous clinical trials with external intelligence from trial registries, regulatory guidance and public sources.

The challenge Bids are priced under time pressure from spreadsheets and memory, and each line is hard to defend when the sponsor pushes back. The challenge Reviewers check each document by hand against regulations, guidance and SOPs, and findings live in email threads and tracked changes. Each draft is checked against ICH GCP, the regulations of each trial country, your SOPs and the rest of the record. The rules that apply, checked ICH GCP, the EU Clinical Trials Regulation, FDA regulations and national law in each trial country.
